File Converter · Preview

File Converter

Images, PDFs, data and text, converted on your device.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

File Converter has these main features: iPhone HEIC, camera RAW and images to JPG, PNG, WebP and PDF; PDF to images, Word and Excel; merge and split. It opens Any image, PDF, CSV, JSON, Markdown, Plain text.

Preview: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with File Converter

  • Convert a PDF to Word (DOCX)
  • Convert a PDF to Excel (XLSX)
  • Convert a PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX)
